summary: Validated update (valid; effect: interpretation append for the value-adoption question, rationale only). It records a citation check on that account: the self-reply behaviour entry already carries the executor-side recovery-trigger material next to the recovery sources, so its conditions naming the executor's dispatch are backed by a registered range, and the receipts bound to the account already cover the adoption, the proposal and the final states - nothing needed changing, so only the check is written down. That completes this run's work, which stands as follows. Six questions, all explained and backed by controller receipts: value adoption replacing the quorum-reported command with a NOOP, up to a completed contradiction of a live replica's committed value (Q1); recovery authority bounded by the recoverer's fixed ballot, with no repair on the rejection path (Q2); the status-guard stall that clears only on the executor's retry, so it is per-attempt rather than permanent (Q3); the client-completion contract holding for the single-NOOP case through re-propose but not for the empty batch (Q4); the wrong-row write in handlePreAccept refuted as unreachable in this snapshot (Q5); and the equal-ballot empty-slice replacement decided by the reply adopted at the slow-quorum trigger position, measured across all six permutations of the three-reply set and four orders of a two-carrier/two-empty set, final because only N - SlowQuorumSize replies can follow and no second dispatch is reachable (Q6). Eleven receipts across six fixed experiments; seven registered source materials spanning the recovery, executor and decoder paths; the two facts plus every behaviour entry mutually consistent in statements, conditions, dependency pointers and citations; the limited over-broad wording found this run corrected rather than left standing; and the captured source tree never modified.
